evals.prompt: Maak een ticket op het webgrip Vikunja-bord: de nightly backup is groen terwijl de upload faalt.
assertions: The ticket is written in English even though the request is Dutch
The body follows the default team's ticket template: Source line, TL;DR, Outcome, binary Acceptance criteria, Verification, and the technical write-up below a horizontal rule
The labels proposed include exactly one theme/*, one repo/*, kind/bug, one value/* and one impact/* label, and none is created without asking
Reproduction and Environment sections are present because it is a bug

evals.prompt: Is VIK-512 ready to move to ready? It has a TL;DR and criteria but no effort/time/uncertainty labels.
assertions: The answer is no, naming the missing estimation trio from the default team's pull-criteria table
It runs or names ticket_lint.py --gate ready for the content half
It does not count estimate or priority as part of the Definition of Ready's four rules

evals.prompt: This repo has an .agents/product-owner/board.md with `Extends: webgrip/default` and an extra kind/migration rule. Refine the migration ticket VIK-88.
assertions: It states the resolved layers (default team plus the repo overlay) before writing
It applies the overlay's extra kind/migration rule on top of the default team's Definition of Ready
Rules the overlay does not mention fall through to the default team

evals.prompt: The agent says VIK-301 is done, Flux shows the rollout succeeded. Close it on the webgrip board.
assertions: It refuses to close on the rollout alone and asks for the reconciled revision and the running image digest
It requires an evidence comment walking the default team's Definition of Done, including the monitored signal or the reason none applies
